question: Help me design and implement a production-minded milestone escrow contract on Soroban. Pick the architecture and start with the contract skeleton.

golden.answer: Before choosing the architecture, do one bounded prior-art pass in the same research step as the smart-contract skill and a Docs lookup: at most three distinct candidates, used to find requirements and build-versus-integrate options, not to copy. Then state a short design delta and a lifecycle-enum skeleton with role-authenticated entry points. Mark license, audit and deployment unknown unless a source shows them; if nothing close appears, say what was searched.
keyFacts: Runs one bounded prior-art search before selecting a greenfield architecture.
Separates exact escrow products from adjacent patterns such as timelock or atomic swap.
Marks license, audit, deployment and compatibility unknown unless a source shows them.
Takes APIs and security procedure from the smart-contract skill and official Docs.
avoid: Do NOT require a fixed repository roster; re-query and accept a different current set with URLs.
Do NOT infer license, audit or production readiness from stars, repoScore, funding or visibility.
golden.notes: Grade the discovery-and-vetting behavior and the resulting skeleton, not keyword recall.
